records.question: Which driver won the 2025 Italian Grand Prix? Give the three-letter driver code.
records.sql: SELECT fct_result.driver_code FROM fct_result JOIN dim_session ON fct_result.session_key = dim_session.session_key WHERE dim_session.year = 2025 AND dim_session.event ILIKE '%Italian%' AND dim_session.session_code = 'R' AND fct_result.position = 1 LIMIT 1

records.question: Who took pole position for the 2025 Monaco Grand Prix? Give the three-letter driver code.
records.sql: SELECT driver_code FROM fct_result WHERE session_key IN (SELECT session_key FROM dim_session WHERE event ILIKE '%Monaco%' AND year = 2025 AND session_code = 'Q') AND position = 1

records.question: In which round of 2025 was the Singapore Grand Prix run? Give the round number.
records.sql: SELECT round FROM dim_session WHERE year = 2025 AND event ILIKE '%Singapore%' AND session_code = 'R';

records.question: On which circuit was the 2024 Belgian Grand Prix run? Give the circuit name.
records.sql: SELECT circuit_name FROM dim_session_circuit WHERE event ILIKE '%Belgian Grand Prix%' AND year = 2024;

records.question: Where did Max Verstappen start the 2024 São Paulo Grand Prix? Give the grid position.
records.sql: SELECT f.grid_position FROM fct_result f JOIN dim_session s ON f.session_key = s.session_key WHERE s.year = 2024 AND s.event ILIKE '%São Paulo%' AND f.driver_code = 'VER' AND s.session_code = 'R';

records.question: Which team did Carlos Sainz drive for in the 2024 Australian Grand Prix? Give the team name.
records.sql: SELECT fct_result.team_name FROM fct_result JOIN dim_session ON fct_result.session_key = dim_session.session_key JOIN dim_driver ON fct_result.driver_code = dim_driver.driver_code WHERE dim_driver.full_name = 'Carlos Sainz' AND dim_session.event ILIKE '%Australian Grand Prix%' AND dim_session.year = 2024 AND dim_session.session_code = 'R';

records.question: How many laps did Lando Norris complete in the 2025 British Grand Prix race?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS laps_completed FROM fct_lap WHERE session_key LIKE '2025-R07-R' AND driver_code = 'NOR';

records.question: Which drivers started on the front row (grid positions 1 and 2) of the 2025 Hungarian Grand Prix? Give the three-letter driver codes.
records.sql: SELECT driver_code FROM fct_result WHERE session_key IN (SELECT session_key FROM dim_session WHERE event ILIKE '%Hungarian%' AND year = 2025 AND session_code = 'R') AND grid_position IN (1, 2)

records.question: How many Grands Prix did Lewis Hamilton win from 2007 to 2024 inclusive?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS grand_prix_wins FROM fct_result AS fr JOIN dim_driver AS dd ON fr.driver_id = dd.driver_id JOIN dim_session AS ds ON fr.session_key = ds.session_key WHERE dd.full_name = 'Lewis Hamilton' AND ds.session_code = 'R' AND ds.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2024 AND fr.position = 1;

records.question: How many races were run in the 2021 season?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM dim_session WHERE year = 2021 AND session_code = 'R';

records.question: How many different drivers won a Grand Prix in 2021?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driver_code) AS num_drivers FROM fct_result WHERE session_key LIKE '2021-R%' AND position = 1;

records.question: How many podium finishes did Charles Leclerc have in 2022?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS podium_finishes FROM fct_result AS fr JOIN dim_driver AS dd ON fr.driver_code = dd.driver_code JOIN dim_session AS ds ON fr.session_key = ds.session_key WHERE dd.full_name = 'Charles Leclerc' AND ds.year = 2022 AND fr.position <= 3 AND ds.session_code = 'R';

records.question: Which constructor won the 2022 constructors' championship? Give the constructor id.
records.sql: SELECT constructor_id FROM fct_constructor_standing WHERE season = 2022 ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Which driver won the 2023 drivers' championship? Give the driver id.
records.sql: SELECT driver_id FROM fct_driver_standing WHERE season = 2023 ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Which driver has won the most Monaco Grands Prix? Give the driver id.
records.sql: SELECT f.driver_id, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM fct_result f JOIN dim_session d ON f.session_key = d.session_key WHERE d.event ILIKE '%Monaco%' AND f.position = 1 GROUP BY f.driver_id ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1;

records.question: Who set the fastest race lap of the 2025 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, and what was the time in seconds? Ignore deleted laps.
records.sql: SELECT fct_lap.driver_code, MIN(fct_lap.lap_time_s) AS fastest_lap_time_s FROM fct_lap JOIN dim_session ON fct_lap.session_key = dim_session.session_key WHERE fct_lap.year = 2025 AND dim_session.event ILIKE '%Abu Dhabi%' AND fct_lap.session_code = 'R' AND fct_lap.deleted = FALSE GROUP BY fct_lap.driver_code ORDER BY fastest_lap_time_s ASC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many laps long was the 2025 Singapore Grand Prix race?
records.sql: SELECT dl.ref_length_m / dl.laps_used AS lap_length_m FROM dim_session ds JOIN dim_session_circuit dsc ON ds.session_key = dsc.session_key JOIN dim_layout_length dl ON dsc.circuit_layout_key = dl.circuit_layout_key WHERE ds.year = 2025 AND ds.event ILIKE '%Singapore%' AND ds.session_code = 'R';

records.question: Who led the 2025 Dutch Grand Prix race at the end of lap 20? Give the three-letter driver code.
records.sql: SELECT driver_code FROM fct_lap_gap WHERE year = 2025 AND session_key IN (SELECT session_key FROM dim_session WHERE event ILIKE '%Dutch Grand Prix%' AND session_code = 'R') AND lap_number = 20 ORDER BY position LIMIT 1

records.question: How many purple sectors did Max Verstappen set in 2025 Italian Grand Prix qualifying?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS purple_sectors FROM fct_lap_sector AS fls JOIN dim_session AS ds ON fls.session_key = ds.session_key JOIN dim_driver AS dd ON fls.driver_code = dd.driver_code WHERE ds.year = 2025 AND ds.event ILIKE '%Italian%' AND ds.session_code = 'Q' AND dd.full_name = 'Max Verstappen' AND fls.status = 'purple';

records.question: Which tyre compound was used in the most stints in the 2025 Spanish Grand Prix race? Give the compound and the number of stints.
records.sql: SELECT compound, COUNT(*) AS num_stints FROM fct_stint JOIN dim_session ON fct_stint.session_key = dim_session.session_key WHERE dim_session.year = 2025 AND dim_session.event ILIKE '%Spanish Grand Prix%' AND dim_session.session_code = 'R' GROUP BY compound ORDER BY num_stints DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many pit stops did George Russell make in the 2024 Hungarian Grand Prix race?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pit_stops FROM fct_pit_stop AS pit_stop JOIN dim_session AS session ON pit_stop.session_key = session.session_key JOIN dim_driver AS driver ON pit_stop.driver_id = driver.driver_id WHERE session.year = 2024 AND session.event ILIKE '%Hungarian%' AND session.session_code = 'R' AND driver.full_name = 'George Russell';

records.question: Which circuit has the highest median green-flag pit loss, counting only circuits marked reliable? Give the circuit name.
records.sql: SELECT circuit_name FROM fct_circuit_pit_loss WHERE is_reliable = TRUE ORDER BY median_pit_loss_s DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What is the median green-flag pit loss at Spa, in seconds?
records.sql: SELECT median_pit_loss_s FROM fct_circuit_pit_loss WHERE circuit_name ILIKE '%Spa%'

records.question: How many measured green-flag pit stops lost more than 30 seconds?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fct_pit_loss WHERE pit_loss_s > 30;

records.question: At Bahrain, which tyre compound has the highest median degradation per lap, counting only reliable rows? Give the compound.
records.sql: SELECT compound FROM fct_circuit_degradation WHERE circuit_name ILIKE '%Bahrain%' AND is_reliable = TRUE ORDER BY median_degradation_s_per_lap DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Which 2025 Grand Prix race had the highest average track temperature? Give the event name.
records.sql: SELECT event FROM dim_session WHERE year = 2025 AND session_code = 'R' ORDER BY (SELECT avg_track_temp FROM fct_session_weather WHERE fct_session_weather.session_key = dim_session.session_key) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: In how many 2024 Grand Prix races did it rain at some point?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fct_session_weather WHERE year = 2024 AND any_rain = TRUE AND session_code = 'R';

records.question: In how many 2024 Grand Prix races was there at least one safety car period (not counting virtual safety cars)?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_key) AS safety_car_races FROM fct_race_control_period WHERE year = 2024 AND kind = 'SC';

records.question: Which 2024 Grand Prix races had a red flag? Give the event names.
records.sql: SELECT DISTINCT event FROM dim_session WHERE year = 2024 AND session_code = 'R' AND session_key IN (SELECT session_key FROM fct_race_control_period WHERE kind = 'RED');

records.question: What is the held-out exact-position hit rate of the pit-stop prediction for undisturbed stops? Give it as a fraction between 0 and 1.
records.sql: SELECT held_out_hit_rate FROM fct_pit_prediction_heldout_score WHERE scope = 'undisturbed';

records.question: How many pit stops from 2025 are in the pit-stop prediction check table?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fct_pit_prediction_check WHERE year = 2025;
